source: TO-3 edition1-65 section3.7/3.8, printed sheets34 and38–40
boundaries: The parsed word is the physical 17-bit AU interface, not a guest instruction.
Bits17/16/9/8 select external/index/immediate/write/read input paths; unused bits are not reinterpreted.
The current binding uses the source class only; shared CPU handlers still own operand values and instruction semantics.
Direct input requires an explicit PVRA/PVRM signal and RPK; no buffer-transfer delay is applied.
Operation-field mapping, other physical input paths, automatic direct signal deadlines and full IZOP sequences remain incomplete.
